cultivar.notes: Cultivar/strain code SLH as reported on COA product line DISVAPE -0:1- 0.5g - SLH - S. Display name: 0:1 SLH Medical Vaporization Oil 0.5g. Not genetically verified.

lab_results.notes: Mapped from a producer-supplied Certificate of Analysis for WeedDAO interoperability review. Original certificate artwork/signatures not republished. Laboratory branded as external-lab-002. Detected cannabinoids/terpenes mapped with unit '%'. ND (Not Detected) cannabinoid/terpene rows omitted from core measurements because v0.1-alpha CannabinoidMeasurement/TerpeneEntry cannot express ND without collapsing to 0 or false not_measured. Heavy metal per-analyte '<0.008 ppm' omitted from numeric values (panel status=pass only). Multi-unit mg/g and mg/unit representations preserved in extensions.weeddao_review. See docs/review-cases/coa-002-gaps.md.

pesticides.notes: COA states Passed; No pesticides detected. Per-analyte ND rows not coerced to numeric zeros.

heavy_metals.notes: COA panel Passed. As/Cd/Pb/Hg each reported as <0.008 ppm — below-reporting-limit strings NOT encoded as value 0. Confirms GitHub issue #1. Per-analyte < strings retained in extensions.weeddao_review.

microbials.notes: COA panel Passed. Yeast/Mold, Salmonella, E.coli reported ND. SafetyAnalyteResult 'not_detected' used for organisms (acceptable for microbial ND; cannabinoid ND has no equivalent in CannabinoidMeasurement).

residual_solvents.notes: COA panel Passed. Listed solvents PASS with limit 5000 ppm each.

provenance.notes: Laboratory results transcribed from a producer-authorized COA for WeedDAO development/review. WeedDAO does not independently re-verify laboratory measurements. Producer Texas Original and TX license 0005 disclosed; laboratory branded identity redacted to external-lab-002.

semantic_notes: ND (Not Detected) is NOT zero and is NOT not_measured.
Heavy metal <0.008 ppm is NOT value 0.
Residual solvent PASS is NOT ND.
Microbial ND mapped to SafetyAnalyteResult not_detected (organism context only).
Cannabinoid/terpene ND cannot be encoded in core CannabinoidMeasurement/TerpeneEntry.
